s2.ptxt: Move the shift lever to P.
Check that the shift lever cannot be shifted out of the P position when operated.
Check that the shift lever can be shifted out of the P position with the IG ON and the brake pedal depressed.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Shift Lock Release Button Operation

s2.ptxt: Check that the shift lever can be shifted out of the P position when operated while pressing the shift lock release button.

item.ptxt: Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform the test with the A/C OFF.

s2.ptxt: Apply the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Start the engine.
While depressing the brake pedal, shift from the N position to the D or R position at idle speed, and measure the time until a slight shock is felt.

specitem.ptxt: N → D position 1.2 seconds or less
N → R position 1.5 seconds or less

item.ptxt: Take several measurements and use the average value.
When measuring repeatedly, allow an interval of 1 minutes.
Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform the test with the A/C OFF.
Do not continuously run the test for 5 seconds or more.
Perform the test in a place with a high μ (coefficient of friction), such as on asphalt, so that the tires do not spin.

s2.ptxt: Apply the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Using SST (TaSCAN), select the following menu items.: Diagnosis / Powertrain / ECT / ECU Data Monitor / Engine Speed
Firmly depress the brake pedal with your left foot, shift to the D position, fully depress the accelerator pedal with your right foot, and quickly read the highest engine speed.

item.ptxt: Before and after measurement, clean the gauges and hoses with white gasoline or equivalent.
Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform the test with the A/C OFF.
Do not continuously run the stall test for 5 seconds or more.
During the stall test, perform it in a place with a high μ (coefficient of friction), such as on asphalt, so that the tires do not spin.

atten4.ptxt: If there is an open or short in the line pressure control solenoid assembly circuit, the line pressure becomes maximum.

s2.ptxt: Remove the test plug, install the automatic transmission oil pressure gauge and adapter C, and start the engine.
Apply the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Firmly depress the brake pedal and shift to the D position.
Using SST (TaSCAN), select the following menu items.: Diagnosis / Powertrain / ECT / Active Test / ECT Shift Position
Select ECU Data Monitor [Engine Speed].
Perform 3 gear in Active Test [ECT Shift Position].
Measure the line pressure at idle speed.
Stop the engine.
Disconnect the transmission control computer connector.

atten4.ptxt: The transmission control computer connector is disconnected only during the D position stall test.

s2.ptxt: Start the engine.
Firmly depress the brake pedal and shift to the D position.
Fully depress the accelerator pedal and quickly measure the line pressure during the stall test.
Stop the engine.
Connect the transmission control computer connector.
Firmly depress the brake pedal and shift to the R position.
Measure the line pressure at idle speed.
Fully depress the accelerator pedal and quickly measure the line pressure during the stall test.
Remove the automatic transmission oil pressure gauge and adapter C, and install the test plug
Using SST (TaSCAN), clear the DTCs by following the instructions on the screen (see ).

atten2.ptxt: Make sure that the road is safe before performing the test.

item.ptxt: Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating ATF temperature (50 to 80°C) and engine coolant temperature of 60°C or more.
Perform with the A/C and cruise control OFF.

If the shift lever is moved from the D position to the M position between IG ON and confirmation that the system is normal (during the system check after IG ON), both the display and control remain in the D position state. M position control is performed by moving from D to M after the system check is finished.

entry.ptxt: (Check D ←→ M switching and "+", "-" switch operation)
While driving at a constant speed of 55 km/h, move the shift lever from the D position to the M position, and check that the meter display changes from D to M5 and the actual gear is 5 gear.

Next, move the shift lever to "-" and check that the meter display changes from M5 → M4, then move it to "+" and check that the meter display changes from M4 → M5, and that the actual gear shifts as shown on the meter.
Shift Shock Level when Driving in D Position
During normal driving, check the shock level at each upshift.
Start off in the D position with a throttle opening of 6%, and check that the upshift speeds 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 gear match the shift points.

While driving at a constant speed on a level road in the D position in the lock-up speed range (80 km/h or more), lightly depress the accelerator pedal and check that the engine speed does not change greatly.
Stop the vehicle on a slope (approximately 5° or more), shift to the P position, and check that the vehicle does not move when the parking brake is released.
Check for abnormal noise and vibration while driving and during shifting.
After the road test, check each part for oil leaks.

Using SST (TaSCAN), select the following menu items.: Diagnosis / Powertrain / ECT / Active Test
